name: Mizusawa Yuuta
source:
Elementary schooler living in [url=https://vndb.org/c41511]Ryou's[/url] neighbourhood.

[spoiler]Yuuta is Ryou's and [url=https://vndb.org/c41508]Mizuki's[/url] childhood friend who died in a car accident.
He summoned his friends to the old school building wanting them to remember him after he was gone.[spoiler]
